entities.summary: Quincy Williams is an American professional football linebacker for the Cleveland Browns of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Murray State Racers and was selected by the Jacksonville Jaguars in the third round of the 2019 NFL draft. He is the older brother of Quinnen Williams.
